project.name: @sylphx/webgpu
project.summary: Foundation native WebGPU package for Node.js and Bun with Rust/wgpu bindings, platform packages, examples, tests, documentation, CI, and release workflow.
goals: Provide a standards-aligned WebGPU implementation for Node.js and Bun through documented package exports.
Keep Rust native bindings, JavaScript wrappers, TypeScript declarations, platform packages, examples, tests, docs, and release artifacts coherent.
Publish consumer-neutral WebGPU behavior and reproducible compatibility claims.
nonGoals: Own one consumer application's rendering policy, shader library, asset pipeline, GPU scheduling policy, or benchmark narrative.
Own the WebGPU standard, wgpu upstream behavior, browser behavior, or all GPU platform driver issues.
Publish enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, org rulesets, rollout issue reconciliation, or shared CI policy.

owns.name: webgpu-native-package
owns.description: The Rust/wgpu native implementation, napi binding surface, JavaScript wrapper, TypeScript declarations, and package export behavior.

owns.name: webgpu-platform-artifacts
owns.description: Platform-specific native packages, build scripts, CI matrix, and release artifact assembly.

owns.name: webgpu-docs-tests-examples
owns.description: Documentation, examples, compatibility tests, and release notes that prove consumer-visible behavior.

doesNotOwn: Consumer app rendering policy, shader libraries, benchmark narratives, product-specific GPU workloads, or asset pipelines.
The WebGPU standard, upstream wgpu behavior, browser behavior, GPU driver behavior, or OS platform policy.
Enterprise doctrine, project manifest schema, rollout issue reconciliation, org rulesets, or shared workflow implementation.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema, standards, and rollout audit
documented napi-rs build and binding behavior

forbiddenCouplings: Do not require consumers to import internal Rust modules, unpublished native artifacts, or private CI outputs instead of package exports.
Do not encode one consumer product's rendering policy, shader assets, GPU workload assumptions, or benchmark narrative as hidden package behavior.
Do not publish native artifacts or compatibility claims without reproducible build, test, package readback, and consumer smoke evidence.
Do not publish enterprise process policy from this repository instead of SylphxAI/doctrine or SylphxAI/.github.

delivery.deployPath: Pull requests run native build and test workflows; main pushes run the release workflow, build platform artifacts, and delegate package release handling to the central reusable release workflow.
delivery.productionProof: Published package changes require CI, native artifact readback, package registry readback, and consumer smoke evidence for affected exports and platform packages.

gaps.description: Upgrade from legacy CI to ADR-29 admission contexts when the native package is ready for full central policy enforcement.
Document registry readback, artifact integrity, and consumer smoke evidence required after native package releases.
Turn supported platforms, native ABI compatibility, WebGPU compliance scope, and benchmark methodology into an ADR or generated compatibility report.
